name: Tabi no Oto: Kamakura-hen
overview: The story follows Hisashi Kawamoto (Yugo Kochi), a young man working at a publishing company in Tokyo, who decides to take a solo trip to Kamakura. During his stay, he encounters various people, including individuals he meets at a guesthouse and along the seaside. Through these experiences, he gradually reflects on himself. The narrative depicts a one-night, two-day trip and explores themes of personal change and growth.
